text:
kevin: Heads-up — planning to cut `release/1.13` today around 16:00 PT. Need someone to own the cut and confirm version bump. Also: changelog deadline and backport rules?

maria.pm: I can own the cut. Propose version `1.13.0`. Can we lock changelog edits by 15:30 PT so I can sweep? cc @sam.releases

sam.releases: I'm available to create the branch and set protection rules. Please drop PRs that need backports here.

julia.eng: Two immediate backports I know of: #9872 (KV-cache bug fix) and #9901 (remove deprecated flag). Both should go to `release/1.12` and `release/1.13` unless we hit conflicts. I'll prepare cherrypicks.

kevin: Thanks. For cherry-picks, prefer `git cherry-pick -x <sha>` to keep provenance. release-bot, can you create the branch and apply required checks?

release-bot: Created branch `release/1.13` at commit `abcdef1`. Protected branch rules applied: required checks = [ci, lint, e2e]. Backport PRs should include label `backport-to-release`.

ops-jen: FYI infra cutover needs the exact branch name to update manifests and deployment pipelines. Send the branch name when live.

sam.releases: Command I'll run:```bash
# mirror what I'll run locally
git fetch origin && git checkout -b release/1.13 origin/main && git push origin release/1.13
```

julia.eng: Quick Q: are we bumping runtime compatibility in this release? If so I'll update `runtime-config.yaml` and open a small PR to the release branch.

kevin: Yes, we'll bump the runtime min to `2.7.0`. All changelog entries go into `CHANGELOG/unreleased/1.13.md` by 15:30 PT — Maria will do the final sweep.

maria.pm: On it. I'll flag anything breaking. :mag:  If we see blocker-level issues we can postpone backport to `1.12` and note it.

alex.qa: I'll queue smoke and basic integration tests as soon as branch is created. Please ping me.

sam.releases: Branch created and pushed. PR to open protection rules: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/12345 :metal:

julia.eng: Draft backport PRs: #9872 -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/12346, #9901 -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/12347. Adding reviewers @kevin @alex.qa.

kevin: If you hit conflicts, resolve locally and include a note in the PR body: `Backport-from: #<orig_pr>` and `Conflict-resolved-by: <your-name>`. Keep commit messages short and include `cherry-picked-from`.

alex.qa: Ran smoke locally against the new branch. Noticed failing e2e around the KV-cache param change (tests flaking). Marking it as blocker for backport PRs until we stabilize.

maria.pm: OK — if the KV-cache fix can't be backported cleanly, we will skip 1.12 backport and document it in the changelog. 1.13 should still include the fix if possible.

sam.releases: Cutoff reminder: feature merges -> 16:00 PT, bugfixes/critical fixes -> 17:00 PT on release branches. Please respect labels so automation can do the right thing.

kevin: Great work, team. I'll post a final status at 15:45 PT. Ping here for any last-minute exceptions. :thumbsup:
